name: Saskatchewan Landing Provincial Park - Bearpaw and Sagebrush Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, Bearpaw A/B + Sagebrush only. Lake Diefenbaker is a reservoir: measured to the high-water edge (where the campground's grass and woods meet the bare and vegetated drawdown flat). Esri World_Imagery z17 frames (0.76 m/px) of Bearpaw and of Sagebrush and a z16 frame of the whole north shore (1.5 m/px), with SKPP GIS points of 30 Bearpaw/Sagebrush sites plotted: Bearpaw A/B lies under continuous canopy: shore-side Bearpaw A B80 is about 50 m inside dense woods from the treeline that marks the high-water edge (z18 frame, 0.38 m/px), Bearpaw B's B106 about 100 m, and SKPP site photos of B41, B42, B80, B81, B82 and B106 show only woods; Sagebrush's south-east sites S30-S34 sit among scattered trees about 110-150 m from it, across the loop's boundary track and an open grass slope. SKPP site photos of S32, S33 and S34 (site ids 6439-6441) show the lake through the trees; S27-S31 show none. Every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. A filtered view from Sagebrush's south-east edge. Riverside/Nighthawk and Bison Hollow, which carried the earlier views, are now their own entries. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290135, read 2026-11-19 (whole-park paging table, 337 rows, + detail pages of 30 Bearpaw/Sagebrush sites): Bearpaw A 107 (105 Nightly Electric + 2 Double Site, B18A and B, B19A and B), Bearpaw B 80 Nightly Electric, Sagebrush 53 (52 Nightly Electric + 1 accessible) = 240 site-specific sites, every one bookable by the night; posted max equipment length 25-82 ft, none under 25 ft (B135 and S17 blank). Park map (2026-06-19): one Campground Access Road off Highway 261 serving Bearpaw and Sagebrush, showers, laundry, groceries and a sani dump in Bearpaw, a service centre and sani dump in Sagebrush. Riverside/Nighthawk and Bison Hollow are now their own entries. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campgrounds at the west end of Lake Diefenbaker, at the historic South Saskatchewan River crossing about 50 km north of Swift Current on Hwy 4: Bearpaw's two loops in woods east of the bridge and Sagebrush in scattered trees beside it, both off one access road from Hwy 261. Bearpaw is set back in the trees from the shore; Sagebrush's south-east sites look at the lake through trees. Showers, laundry and groceries are in Bearpaw. Riverside and Nighthawk about 2 km east and Bison Hollow about 5 km west have their own entries; a separate equestrian campground on the south shore has non-electric horse sites. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates. Full services May 14 to September 30; October camping on electric sites booked through the park office, with portable toilets and the dump station. No winter camping.

fees.note: $4 a night less from October 1, with reduced services.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept Bearpaw A/B + Sagebrush (240 sites, the largest group); the stored pin 50.6772,-107.948 (on Bearpaw B by B110, about 15 m from the group's site-count-weighted centroid 50.6771,-107.9479) stays. Riverside + Nighthawk (60 sites, centroid 50.6885,-107.9267, 1.96 km east; nearest sites S30-R1 1.21 km; own road from a separate junction on Hwy 261, about 2.4 km by road) and Bison Hollow (24 sites + Prairie Meadow group areas, centroid 50.6631,-108.0163, 5.07 km west; nearest sites B1-BH1 4.49 km across Hwy 4, about 12.5 km by road) became new entries. Within this group the loops sit together off one Campground Access Road (Bearpaw A-B 0.49 km, Bearpaw B-Sagebrush 0.40 km), so they stay together. --Claude
